text.description_html:
Laurey 37528, Hammered Merlot Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull

If you are looking for unique cabinet hardware, look no further. This Art Deco inspired Merlot Kitchen Cabinet Pull features a hammered design that beautifully catches the finish color to add dimension and drama to any lightweight door or drawer. The Hammered Merlot Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull has 3 inch mounting centers and is 4.5 inches long overall. The Hammered Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull comes packaged with mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Merlot Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 37528 3 Inch Merlot Pull in Satin Nickel:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 5/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
